title: In situ synthesis of ultrafine Cu(II) metal immobilized on pectin hydrogel, modified by a CoFe2O4/Pr-SO3H nanocomposite as a green catalyst for reduction of nitro compounds and synthesis of 1H-tetrazoles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1358-1374
